text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year!!
Oshogatsu is SO exciting!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I learned how to pray at the shrine! Put the money in the box and give a round of applause, right?!
choice_data_list: I doubt they'll give a standing ovation...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? I thought hyping things up
would let the gods enjoy it more too, though.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okaaay, let's go visit the shrine together!
And so, after finishing our shrine visit with Taiki Shuttle—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I asked them to watch me become Horse Girl of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We worked super hard all of last year,
so now we're just waiting for the announcement!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll be chosen as the "Umamusume of the Year"
and make God happy too♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, what did you wish for?
Did you wish to become the prime minister?
choice_data_list: I pray I can help Taiki grow stronger and stronger
I pray Taiki's running keeps improving

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh!? You put in a good word
for me?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be that you found out
I stayed up late last night?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right! To stay healthy,
I will also make sure to go to sleep early, yes!
"And so, after finishing the New Year's shrine visit, the URA Horse of the Year would soon be decided...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you!
Leave my rapid growth to me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I will grow and definitely
seize the dream!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I feel power surging through ME!
Trainer, let's TRAIN!
"And so, after finishing the New Year's shrine visit, the URA Horse of the Year would soon be decided...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Improvement?
Do you mean tips on how to run, yess?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
That is just what I wished for, too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm especially bad at getting out of the gate,
so please give me plenty of help there, pllleeease!
"And so, after finishing the New Year's shrine visit, the URA Horse of the Year would soon be decided...!"
